page_title: LUT 1-2 WHU | Luton v West Ham 01/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Luton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' 1 - 2 Goal! Carlton Morris finds Mads Juel Andersen (Luton) with a headed pass and the latter glances a header past the goalkeeper to make it 1:2.
90+1' Substitution. Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) replaces Lucas Paqueta.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' The foul by Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Paul Tierney.
85' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) finds himself some space to connect with a well-executed corner kick and his header leaves the goalkeeper totally helpless. The effort ricochets in off the right post.
85' The ball is out of play. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner.
84' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
84' Rob Edwards prepares a substitution. Tahith Chong is replaced by Cauley Woodrow (Luton).
84' Carlton Morris (Luton) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
81' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Emerson (West Ham) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
80' Substitution. Michail Antonio walks off the pitch and Danny Ings (West Ham) comes on as a substitute.
79' Jacob Brown (Luton) commits a foul and Paul Tierney immediately signals a free kick.
78' Rob Edwards is forced to make a change. Alfie Doughty (Luton) is unable to continue due to injury, Chiedozie Ogbene comes on.
76' The game is interrupted now, Alfie Doughty (Luton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alphonse Areola, who smothers the ball.
73' A corner kick by Luton is thwarted by the well prepared Alphonse Areola (West Ham).
73' Jacob Brown (Luton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Luton.
71' Substitution. Pablo Fornals (West Ham) has come on for Mohamed Said Benrahma.
71' The game is interrupted as Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is flagged offside.
71' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Issa Kabore (Luton) replacing Ryan Giles.
71' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute Elijah Adebayo and he is replaced by Jacob Brown (Luton).
71' The substitution is prepared. Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ross Barkley.
70' A spell of possession for West Ham in an attempt to control the game.
68' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
63' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Thomas Kaminski.
63' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

63' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to West Ham.

62' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Reece Burke (Luton), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
62' The ball goes out of play and Luton have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Reece Burke (Luton) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
61' The referee points to the corner flag and Luton will take a corner.
61' Ryan Giles (Luton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
56' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
54' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alfie Doughty (Luton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
54' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ryan Giles (Luton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
52' The goal by West Ham is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
52' The West Ham players halt their celebrations as referee Paul Tierney makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
51' Emerson (West Ham) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
50' West Ham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
50' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
48' Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Paul Tierney blows for a foul.
46' Flag goes up against Michail Antonio (West Ham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' Referee Paul Tierney blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
45+2' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. West Ham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45+1' Ross Barkley (Luton) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
45+1' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) was too forceful with his tackle and Paul Tierney interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Luton have a free kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Tahith Chong (Luton) is first to a rebound inside the 6-yard box, but he misdirects his shot well wide of the left post.
44' The linesman points to the corner flag, Luton are going to take it.
44' A cross from Tahith Chong (Luton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
41' Carlton Morris (Luton) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
39' Paul Tierney couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Michail Antonio (West Ham) and blew his whistle.
37' 0 - 1 Goal! Lucas Paqueta picks out Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom right corner with a header from close range. 0:1.
36' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
36' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
33' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) offside.
31' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) is penalised for a foul. Paul Tierney had a clear view and blows his whistle.
29' A rebound falls at the feet of Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies well wide of the left post.
29' West Ham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
29' Emerson (West Ham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball goes out for a corner. West Ham can continue in their attacking effort.
26' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
24' Mads Juel Andersen (Luton) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the right post. What a poor effort.
23' The referee signals a corner kick to Luton.
23' Alfie Doughty (Luton) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
23' Alfie Doughty (Luton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Luton earn a corner.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Luton.
21' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
19' The foul by Michail Antonio (West Ham) was seen by Paul Tierney who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
18' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
18' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.

15' Ambitious effort from Ross Barkley (Luton). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post.
14' An attempted cross from Ryan Giles (Luton) is cleared.
13' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the left post.
12' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
7' Ross Barkley (Luton) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
7' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) commits a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.

2' Ross Barkley (Luton) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
